name: proto-buf-work-listing-its-own-directory
description: A buf.work.yaml that lists no directory but its own is no workspace, as buf reads it, so it names no import root and the target is read with the default roots: an import no root resolves fails its file, which publishes nothing and carries an unresolved-import note. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
